post.description: Records a user interaction with a content node (repository, activity, container, or element). Updates the learner's 6-dimensional affinity scores (topic, skill, concept, industry, tool, goal) based on content tags and creates a visit entry for analytics. The context.entryPoint field tracks how the user discovered the content: search, recommendation, browse, pathway, continue, or direct.

Processes onboarding survey responses to create the initial learner profile. Each answer maps to tag affinities that seed the 6-dimensional profile (topic, skill, concept, industry, tool, goal). Also extracts experience level and learning goals from relevant questions.
post.summary: Initialize learner profile with onboarding survey

get.description: Returns content the learner has started but not completed, sorted by most recent visit. Designed for "Continue Learning" UI sections. Use includeCompleted to also return finished items for review purposes.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, sorted by last visit timestamp (most recent first)

parameters.name: includeCompleted
parameters.description: Include items the learner has completed (progress=100). Disabled by default to focus on unfinished content

get.description: Returns content ranked by how well it matches the learner's affinity profile. By default excludes completed items and boosts recently-visited content. Use includeCompleted to show finished items, onlyInProgress to filter to started content, and boostRecent/recentBoostWeight/recentDays to control recency scoring.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of recommendations to return, sorted by relevance score (highest first)

parameters.name: includeCompleted
parameters.description: Include repositories the learner has completed (progress=100). Disabled by default to focus on new learning opportunities

parameters.name: onlyInProgress
parameters.description: Only show repositories the learner has started (has visit history). Useful for "resume learning" focused recommendations

parameters.name: boostRecent
parameters.description: Boost relevance score for content with recent interactions. Recent activity signals active interest and learning momentum

parameters.name: recentBoostWeight
parameters.description: Weight multiplier for recency boost (0-1). Higher values prioritize recent activity over pure profile match quality

parameters.name: recentDays
parameters.description: Number of days to consider for "recent" interactions. Activity older than this threshold receives no recency boost

get.description: Returns content similar to a given repository based on shared tags and problems addressed. Results are ranked by overlap score. Use sectionId to match against a specific section's tags rather than the full repository. Useful for "More Like This" UI sections.

parameters.name: sectionId
parameters.description: Section (activity) id for section-level matching. When provided, recommendations are based on section tags rather than full repository

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of related content suggestions to return, sorted by similarity score (highest first)

delete.description: Admin-only endpoint to clear any user's learning data. Set resetOnboarding to clear survey responses. Set resetProgress to clear visit history, affinities, and engagement metrics. If neither flag is set, resets both.

post.description: Uses the configured AI provider to generate text from a prompt. Used for generating client profiles from survey answers and post-conversation analysis/reflection.

post.summary: Chat with AI using a system prompt and message history

post.description: Creates a short-lived client secret that allows the browser to establish a direct WebRTC connection to OpenAI's Realtime API. The session is pre-configured with the client role-play instructions.

post.description: Answers a free-text question about the catalog, recommends content, or proposes a learning pathway. The endpoint is stateless: the client replays the whole conversation on every turn.
